note: Source of truth of the feature registry. FEATURE-REGISTRY.md is generated from this file by `cargo xtask features --write` and checked by `cargo xtask features --check` (CI). Never reuse an id. Do not set an implementation status without evidence.

features.name: Voxel coordinates, brick keys and regions
features.description: i64 voxel and brick coordinates, floor division for negative space, cell keys with level, half-open regions.
features.criteria: Negative coordinates symmetric; no overflow wrap; deterministic ordering.

features.name: Sparse brick storage with explicit absent-data states
features.description: Cell store with Present, KnownEmpty, NotLoaded, OutsideBounds and LoadFailure never merged.
features.criteria: Unloaded or failed data is never reported as empty.

features.name: Revisions, epochs and region stamps
features.description: Monotonic per-resource revisions with epochs, incomparable-is-stale rule, region stamps.
features.criteria: Overflow is an error; stamps are order independent.

features.name: Atomic commit gate and mutation boundary
features.description: Single commit primitive reachable only through user, system and recovery handles; batches apply entirely or not at all.
features.criteria: No direct write path; loom model of the gate; compile-fail bypass tests.

features.name: Export/import views and stable content hash
features.description: Plain-data view of an asset and a content fingerprint independent of encoding.
features.criteria: Round trip restores revisions and content; hash independent of channel encoding.

features.name: Geometry bounds
features.description: Checked integer boxes: union, intersection, growth, level conversion, transform; no world-size limit.
features.criteria: Overflow is an error; property tests for the algebra.

features.name: World identity values
features.description: WorldSeed and GeneratorVersion newtypes with fixed-width byte forms.
features.criteria: Exact comparison; stable byte form.

features.name: Material palette (content ids to runtime indices)
features.description: Namespaced content ids, runtime indices with air = 0, collision diagnostics, strict and recovery-mode resolution of saved tables. Provisional (C-10).
features.criteria: Unknown content is an error or a visible placeholder, never another material.

features.name: Immutable snapshots with apron
features.description: Pin-only brick neighbourhood snapshots with per-brick input stamps.
features.criteria: Snapshot isolation under concurrent commits; apron consistency.

features.name: Derived-data executor with stale-result rejection and caps
features.description: Provider graph, task state machine, cancellation, single publish path that rejects stale results, pin and lifetime budgets.
features.criteria: No stale result is ever published (loom, stress); caps enforced on the synthetic mobile budget.

features.name: Editing API contracts
features.description: Operations, transactions, results, conflicts, authorization context, backend and storage ports.
features.criteria: No behaviour in the crate; API snapshot guards changes.

features.name: Transactional editing through one user commit path
features.description: Authorization, backend dispatch, private overlay, expected-revision conflicts, atomic commit, rollback, cancel.
features.criteria: A failed or conflicting transaction changes nothing; only user commits arise from user requests.

features.name: Idempotent retry by operation id, including after a restart
features.description: Committed operations are not applied twice; the retry table is rebuilt from the journal and bounded safely; undecided intents block retries until resolved.
features.criteria: Confirmed op not re-applied after restart; same id with other content refused.

features.name: Observers and dirty propagation after commit
features.description: Dirty regions go to Processing, then observers in registration order; observer failures are isolated.
features.criteria: Observers see post-commit state only; order equals commit order. Known limit: callbacks run inside the commit section (TD-1).

features.name: Voxel editing operations
features.description: Set, replace, fill air, clear, copy and move (with rotation) of voxel regions as write sets, at any level, with no world-size limit.
features.criteria: Unloaded bricks never guessed; other channels preserved; brute-force model equality.

features.name: Faces mesh provider (reference oracle)
features.description: Visible unit faces per brick with apron; the correctness reference for meshing.
features.criteria: Equals the brute-force definition across brick borders.

features.name: Greedy mesh provider
features.description: Material-aware merging of coplanar faces with a unit-ring seam rule; optimisation candidate, not the default renderer.
features.criteria: Coverage equals faces; no T-junctions. Known limit: T-junctions inside a brick are not claimed fixed.

features.name: Incremental mesh rebuild by a dirty rule
features.description: After a commit only the brick and its six face neighbours need new meshes.
features.criteria: Incremental rebuild equals full rebuild over random edits.

features.name: Voxel collision boxes
features.description: Disjoint boxes covering exactly the solid voxels of a brick; unknown is never free space.
features.criteria: Boxes equal the voxel model; stale results never served.

features.name: One-step voxel LOD
features.description: A coarser derived level per brick; presence of thin structures survives.
features.criteria: Equals brute-force coarsening; authoritative data untouched. Mixed-resolution neighbours belong to PS-9.

features.name: SDF backend
features.description: Technical SDF representation behind the backend port; not a required building mechanic.
features.criteria: SDF-01..03 pass backend conformance; no implicit voxel to SDF conversion.

features.name: Mesh backend
features.description: Mesh pages with validation and normal recalculation behind the backend port.
features.criteria: MSH-01..03 pass backend conformance; typed topology errors.

features.name: Backend conformance suite
features.description: Generic suite every backend must pass, self-checked against broken fakes.
features.criteria: Nine broken fakes are each caught; voxel backend passes.

features.name: Versioned checksummed record codec (experimental)
features.description: Asset snapshots, journal records and write batches with schema version, CRC-32 and size limits. Not an approved format.
features.criteria: Every byte flip and truncation detected; hostile counts refused without allocation.

features.name: Atomic snapshot save and load
features.description: Temp file, fsync, rename, directory sync; load verifies the checksum.
features.criteria: Every modelled crash point leaves a complete old or new snapshot. Model and real-directory evidence only; no device durability (DG-2).

features.name: Write-ahead journal with payload and replay
features.description: Intent/Confirmed/Aborted phases, write payload, reconciliation and replay of confirmed changes after the last snapshot.
features.criteria: Replay is idempotent and reproduces the pre-crash world. The journal is a contract fake in tests: no file journal yet; CB-1 (commit and journal not atomic) is open.

features.name: Durable journal file, manifest, snapshot store, compaction
features.description: File-backed operation journal, world record (seed and generator version), manifest, snapshot store and compaction keeping the last recoverable state.
features.criteria: PERS-02..05 integrated; crash-recovery matrix passes; generator version never changed silently.

features.name: Crash-point fault-injection harness
features.description: In-memory filesystem with a weakest-POSIX model and a runner that crashes a scenario after every step.
features.criteria: Finds a missing fsync; a model is not proof of real platform behaviour.

features.name: Final save format
features.description: The approved on-disk format of worlds, journals and snapshots.
features.criteria: GOV-10 approved after RG-1.

features.name: Create a world from a seed
features.description: Deterministic pure generator producing terrain for a seed and generator version, materialised by the system writer.
features.criteria: Same seed and version give the same world on every platform. Product detail (terrain variants) still needs owner approval.

features.name: See the world in a game window
features.description: Client renders derived meshes of the loaded region.
features.criteria: Mesh of a generated region visible on desktop.

features.name: Camera and character control
features.description: Move a camera or a character through the world with voxel collision.
features.criteria: Walk and jump on generated terrain without falling through.

features.name: Player places and removes a block
features.description: Input in the game window becomes an editing operation through the production chain.
features.criteria: A placed block is visible, authoritative and survives save and load.

features.name: Sculpt brush
features.description: One sculpt stroke is one transaction.
features.criteria: Stroke commits atomically (DEC-084); tool behaviour needs product detail.

features.name: Boolean operations on regions
features.description: Boolean tools over the editing API.
features.criteria: Needs product detail.

features.name: Undo and redo
features.description: History of confirmed operations with one stroke as one unit.
features.criteria: Undo respects authorization; History does not own journal or storage.

features.name: Level-aware voxel editing (micro-voxel levels)
features.description: Keys, storage, operations and providers work at any non-negative level.
features.criteria: An operation at level 2 touches only level 2 data.

features.name: Selective micro-voxel detail and resampling
features.description: Promote parts of a brick to finer levels and convert between resolutions.
features.criteria: Mixed-resolution neighbours consistent.

features.name: Composite geometry
features.description: Assemblies of layers and junctions.
features.criteria: Needs product detail.

features.name: Authoritative server runtime
features.description: Single-writer authoritative world with authorization at the server.
features.criteria: Needs product detail; permission schema owner is Server/Authorization (DEC-083).

features.name: Multiplayer synchronisation
features.description: Replication of operations and deltas to clients.
features.criteria: Needs product detail.

features.name: Character, inventory, crafting, combat and creatures
features.description: RPG systems proposed for the first playable slice (character, items, resources, one hostile and one passive creature, minimal combat).
features.criteria: Product detail and a gameplay owner are still required; this entry is a placeholder for the later split into separate features.

features.name: Content packages and mods
features.description: Registration of materials and content by package; later loading of mods.
features.criteria: Palette model exists (F-CORE-008); no Mod SDK is planned yet.

features.name: Architecture and quality checks in CI
features.description: fmt, clippy, tests on Linux and Windows, loom, cargo-deny, archcheck with mutation-boundary and conflict-marker rules, API snapshots.
features.criteria: Required checks block integration into dev.

features.name: Mobile device validation
features.description: Memory, determinism, durability and release checks on physical devices.
features.criteria: Device gates pass on a physical device matrix; CI-host results are never device measurements.
